title: 更多规则，更长列表？在隐藏规则课程上基准测试自进化智能体
summary: 提出CLR-Bench基准，用逐层叠加隐藏规则的课程测试自进化智能体能否真正学会未明示的规则。六种方法在认证模型上提升不足5分，且常靠记录例外而非归纳规则；固定提示可提升14.5-16.5分，更强模型能仅凭反馈学习。
summary_en: Introduces CLR-Bench, a curriculum of latent rules benchmark testing whether self-evolving agents can learn unstated rules. Six methods gain under 5 points on a certifying model and mostly record exceptions rather than induce rules; a fixed convention hint lifts them 14.5-16.5 points, and stronger models learn from feedback alone.
